An experimental setup includes a source emitter, a double-slit barrier, and a detector screen. When source is on, particles pass through available slits in barrier, and get detected by detector screen where an interference pattern can form. You can change the setup by changing particle type, configuring slits in barrier, or moving detector screen. You can compare and analyze collected data by zooming in or taking snapshots of detector screen and by examining available graph. Time Controls are available to pause or speed up data collection when in hits mode.

An experimental setup includes a source emitter, a double-slit barrier, and a detector screen. When source is on, a zoomed-in wave area shows wave fronts advancing toward slitted barrier. As waves emerge from available slits in barrier, they can interact and can form an interference pattern when detected by detector screen. You can change the setup by adjusting source, changing particle type, and configuring slits and barrier. You can compare and analyze intensity or hits data by zooming in or taking snapshots of detector screen and by examining available graph. Additionally, advancing wave can be displayed as oscillating peaks and valleys or as amplitude. Time Controls are available to pause or change speed of wave visualization.

An experimental setup includes a source emitter, a double-slit barrier, and a detector screen. Source emitter can fire single particles one at a time or continuously fire single particles. When source is on, a zoomed-in wave area shows wave packets advancing toward slitted barrier. As waves emerge from available slits in barrier, they can interact and can form an interference pattern when detected by detector screen. You can change the setup by adjusting source, changing particle type, and configuring slits and barrier. You can compare and analyze hits data by zooming in or taking snapshots of detector screen and by examining available graph. Additionally, advancing wave packet can be displayed as oscillating peaks and valleys or as amplitude. Time Controls are available to pause or change speed of wave packet visualization.
